packs.title: Art, Gardens and Lagoon
packs.promise: Explore West Palm Beach through art, parks, wetlands and the lagoon.

q.s: Read sculpture and garden as two kinds of form.
st: Check the operator’s current season before visiting; do not enter closed grounds.
Choose one sculpture form and one garden form from an open visit or official images.
Make a small paired sketch or description of their different edges.

q.s: Make a pattern key from a changing design district.
st: Walk only open public Northwood Village blocks and choose three facade, sign-shape or planting details.
Record a repeating color, material or rhythm without copying readable business text.
Arrange the details into a small district pattern key.

q.s: Compare foliage in a botanical garden.
st: Use an open paid garden visit or the operator’s official plant images.
Choose three leaves with different outlines; identify a plant only if the garden does.
Draw or describe a tiny route between their shapes, not a claim about current bloom.

packs.title: Waterfront on Foot
packs.promise: Trace ten connected downtown stories from the waterfront to CityPlace.

q.s: Frame land and lagoon from public ground.
st: Check that the city dock is open to pedestrians and remain inside public railings.
Choose one view toward the city and one toward Lake Worth Lagoon.
Record a plant, built or water detail in each view without entering a boat area.

q.s: Separate an old courthouse from current courts.
st: View the restored courthouse exterior from an open sidewalk or visit the museum when open.
Find two architectural cues in the exterior and one role the building serves now.
Write a sentence that clearly distinguishes historic courtroom interpretation from current court services.

q.s: Choose one public artwork and one gathering edge.
st: Find an artwork in an open public CityPlace space, or use the operator’s current art page.
Record its listed title or artist only if supplied by a site label or official page.
Sketch or describe one nearby edge where people can gather without blocking a route.
